lane_title: Far-Field Geothermal, Basement-Dipole & Road-Deconfounded Antislope Nested Hide-and-Recover with Basin-and-Range Regime Allocation
prior_lanes_kept_stopped_and_archived: H79-NHR (X1, negative, 0.1431/0.1522 holdout but duplicated 26 near-trace priors at 0.913)

shared_modules.uniqueness: vendor/gems57/uniqueness.py::compare_array_to_registry (dot_definition='chance-calibrated-v4', IR-79-60 resolving IR-79-53; raw 'budget-matched-v3' and 'literal' reported side by side)

model_architecture.head_phys: Out-of-quadrant HistGradientBoostingRegressor fitted strictly on train_region physical/geothermal/scarp features X_phys against true kernel target k(d(x, visible)) across 100% of visible faults in train_region (zero catalogue geometry features; zero false negatives).
model_architecture.head_nest: Decontaminated nested component hide-and-recover HistGradientBoostingRegressor (3 nested replicates per fold, 20% component hide, buffer_px=3) with pixels at d(x, remaining) < 3.0 px excluded from negative pool (IR-79-61 fix) and X_full = [X_phys, fold-strict network continuation features].
model_architecture.blend_rule: Smooth physical crossover S(x) = (1 - lambda(d(x))) * rank_norm(s_nest(x)) + lambda(d(x)) * rank_norm(s_phys(x)), where lambda(d) = d^2 / (d^2 + d0^2), d0 = 12.0 px (1.2 km).
model_architecture.placement_rule: Greedy 3.0 px minimum-spacing non-maximum suppression emitting exact budget B = 37,654 binary 1.0 dots across preregistered fold-strict distance bands R0=(2,5], R1=(5,10], R2=(10,20], R3=(20,50], R4=(50,inf) px (zero dots wasted on existing_faults.tif or outside footprint; residual backfill from full ranked allowed pool if any band exhausts non-overlapping slots).

F2.label: Balanced Relay, Step-Over & Geothermal Basin Regime (40% <=1km / 60% >1km)

automatic_gate_and_selection_protocol.step_1_surface_novelty_pre_placement: Before placing final dots for an arm, scan its continuous full-catalogue score surface against all accessible registry + sibling git-delta + prior GEMSDOE79 rasters under dot_definition='chance-calibrated-v4'. Require max |Spearman rho| <= 0.90 across ALL rasters, zero raw > 0.70 overlaps on ALL informative rasters (halo_coverage <= 0.70), and zero chance-calibrated duplicates across ALL rasters. Any arm failing pre-placement surface scan is immediately disqualified.
automatic_gate_and_selection_protocol.step_2_final_binary_novelty: After placement via greedy 3.0 px NMS (B = 37,654), scan final binary GeoTIFF against all accessible rasters under literal, budget-matched-v3, and chance-calibrated-v4. Require unique == True under chance-calibrated-v4 (0 duplicates across ALL 1,205 rasters, including 0 raw > 0.70 overlaps across ALL 1,167 informative rasters).
automatic_gate_and_selection_protocol.step_3_leakage_canary: Require single-feature symmetric AUC <= 0.90 across all features and all 4 folds on both seed 20 and seed 30.
automatic_gate_and_selection_protocol.step_4_holdout_dominance: On BOTH seed 20 and seed 30 under gems57-pooled-hide-v2 (1,000 paired 20 km spatial-block bootstrap draws), require candidate DTI > control DTI AND paired difference 95% CI lower bound > 0 against H33 fold-fair control, uniform random control, and pure-physics control.
automatic_gate_and_selection_protocol.step_5_deterministic_winner_choice: Among arms in {F1, F2, F3} passing Steps 1-4 with fraction_gt_10px >= 0.50, select the unique arm maximizing mean pooled HOLDOUT-DTI across seed 20 and seed 30 and emit verdict='promote' to separate selector scripts/select_submission.py. If zero arms pass Steps 1-4, emit verdict='negative' and ok_to_submit=false.
